Sparkling Tones for desktop, part four: live view and MIDI footswitch.
The live view turns your screen into a pedalboard: big tiles, easy to hit on stage.
Click a tile, and that sound plays. The light shows which one is on.
Got a MIDI footswitch? Under "Foot controller" you assign a switch to each tile, and play hands-free.
Sparkling Tones: free, for Windows and in your browser. Next: generate with AI.
